related_questions.question: Which COVID test is most accurate?

text_blocks.snippet: Molecular tests, also known as PCR tests, are generally the most accurate for detecting COVID-19. They are processed in a laboratory and can take longer to produce results, but they are highly sensitive and can detect even small amounts of the virus. Antigen tests, also known as rapid tests, are less accurate but offer faster results, often within 15 minutes. They are more likely to produce false negatives, especially if viral load is low. At-home tests are generally most effective when symptoms are present.
